semantics.batch_semantics: A batch repeats the same prepared-input circuit with independent shots; every attempted shot remains one complete addition.
semantics.logical_work: Execute the full prepared-basis-input adder once per attempted shot, preserving a and computing b=(a+b) mod 65536. Measure qubits 0..31 in order, with each 16-bit register little-endian; observable 0 is the raw parity of the two most significant sum bits and is zero. Reductions on these fixed basis inputs do not describe arbitrary superposition inputs.
